title: Wireframe by @okkshitij: Introducing /playground: a design canvas for your code. Available now:
notes:
Introducing /playground: a design canvas for your code. Available now: `npx design-playground` Drop any vibe coded prototype onto the canvas, add any component from your design system. Drag to iterate. Enter custom prompts. Your agent can control the canvas and create variations for you. Run multiple in parallel if needed. Link to full docs below ↓

Designer: @okkshitij. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
